title: Length of the Kestrel Return Balance Plan by Tier
content:
**Plan terms — spreading the return charges.** On a returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, the return charges (the excess mileage charge, the excess wear charge and the return fee billed for the return) may be spread over monthly installments of the Kestrel return balance plan:

- a contract in Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1 or Tier 1+ with no balloon returned payment in the 12 calendar months ending on the payment date spreads its return charges over a number of monthly installments equal to the return charges divided by USD 300.00, rounded down to a whole number and held between 2 and 4, and the part of the return charges paid now is the return charges divided by that number;
- a contract in Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 4 or Tier 5 with no balloon returned payment in those months spreads its return charges over 2 monthly installments, the part paid now being the return charges divided by 2;
- any other contract pays its return charges in one payment.

A window of 12 calendar months ending on the payment date takes in the dates on or before the payment date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

## Installment count for Tier 3 to Tier 1+ (hypothetical return charges)

| Return charges | Divided by 300.00, rounded down | Held between 2 and 4 | Part paid now |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 450.00 | 1 | 2 | USD 225.00 |
| USD 1,050.00 | 3 | 3 | USD 350.00 |
| USD 1,800.00 | 6 | 4 | USD 450.00 |

A returned payment in the 12 months moves any tier to one payment of the whole return charges.
